title: Emerald
desc: Named and built the 'Emerald' app, a full-stack platform to fetch, normalise, and visualise energy market time-series data. Deployed on AWS using Elastic Beanstalk for scalable data processing.

title: Trailstone Config Service
desc: Collaborated with another Team to develop a service that allows users to modify application settings and test it on the emerald app to inject new TSIDs into tanstack table on the fly.

title: Laochra 2D Game
quickDesc: A Viking-themed 2D adventure built with Pygame.
desc: A top-down 2D adventure game featuring custom sprite animation, collision detection, and state management. Built entirely in Python using the Pygame library to demonstrate OOP principles.

title: TacoCloud
quickDesc: Full-stack ordering system built with Spring Boot.
desc: A full-stack application allowing users to design custom tacos. Features Spring Security for authentication, Spring Data JPA for persistence, and a REST API for the frontend.

title: Nutrition Meal App
quickDesc: Nutrition tracking and meal planning application.
desc: A meal planning and nutrition tracking application. Users can manage recipes, track daily caloric intake, and generate shopping lists based on meal plans.

title: Staff Rota System
quickDesc: Upgrading a legacy scheduling system for TM356.
desc: For my TM356 module, my project involves upgrading a previous workplace system that is not fit for purpose. This project focuses on modernizing the UI and backend logic to improve staff scheduling efficiency.
